carriers.name: Social cover
carriers.title_priority: dominant; preserve exact three-element text budget
carriers.object_scale: medium to large; readable at thumbnail size
carriers.crop_behavior: one decisive edge crop or one intentional counter-space placement

carriers.name: Editorial wall poster
critical_signals: visible poster edge or mounting logic
carriers.safe_margin: 5–9% of page width unless the poster crop is intentionally aggressive
carriers.title_priority: dominant; supporting information stays subordinate and attaches to the title axis, frame, object tangent, perspective line, mask, or perimeter
carriers.crop_behavior: allow decisive crop at one or more edges

carriers.name: Photo-led cover
carriers.safe_margin: platform or editorial preset safe zone
carriers.title_priority: dominant but may enter or lock tightly to the image field
carriers.object_scale: image field 45–80% of the page or a deliberate fragment
carriers.crop_behavior: preserve 2–4 identity anchors; crop one nonessential region

carriers.name: Packaging face
critical_signals: seam, fold, label boundary, or die-cut implication
forbidden_signals: barcode, QR code, or fake certification
carriers.safe_margin: keep all three approved text elements inside the face-safe area
carriers.object_scale: one object or object cluster at 30–70% of the face
carriers.crop_behavior: use label boundary or seam as structure, not as a UI card

carriers.name: Record or playlist sleeve
critical_signals: one strong image or typographic event
carriers.title_priority: dominant; typography may become the primary object
carriers.object_scale: one large object or title-object relationship
carriers.crop_behavior: allow square-edge crop or one off-center object
